body:
The notebook now closes a delayed-dispatch gap in its digital holding proof. A reading can be old when its command reaches the drive. Two fixed pending-command cases preserve one physical state and the original timestamp, derive the startup and feedback-error bounds, and prove containment with a first dispatch delay of at most 0.5 ms and total reading age at most 1 ms.

A second conditional theorem bounds first zero velocity and upper position when effective braking returns by a known time. It derives the loss-phase acceleration cap and retains an exponential upper envelope with only a recovered response-rate floor. The simple closed-form bound is deliberately graded separately: it returns 160.5859375 mm on the old 150 mm clearance case, so it does not replace the sharper certificate.

The same notebook preserves the preceding retained-history robot motion certificates, common-state comparisons, offline client, manuscript and Manim explanation, plus source-grounded Geometric Unity algebra. The algebra does not validate physics. Earlier failures and toolchain pins remain intact.

Validation:

- Independent handoff review passed copied-source builds, 100 standard-axiom closure audits, separate kernel checks and six negative controls. Both nonzero-delay witnesses were checked.
- Independent recovery review rebuilt 31 local dependency modules and six research modules. Its 87 accepted checks include 27 axiom closures, 39 separate kernel checks and seven mathematical rejections. One critic-only tactic failure was preserved and repaired; the builder proof needed no change.
- Root checked source, report, log and acceptance bindings in both the working folder and notebook copy. The 74 older frozen manifests and the preceding digital-hold packet were preserved. The notebook sync and committed Git blob identities have separate checks.
- Figures explain total reading age, the fixed-admission gap and conservatism. Their numerical screens remain separate from Lean and physical evidence.

Start with the [recovery and handoff review packet](https://github.com/IamMikeHelsel/ctrl/blob/target/research-notebook-20261017/research-notebook/research/pods/2026-10-18/recovery-handoff-02/REVIEW-ME.txt), [root scope/value grade](https://github.com/IamMikeHelsel/ctrl/blob/target/research-notebook-20261017/research-notebook/research/pods/2026-10-18/recovery-handoff-02/ROOT-GRADE.txt), and [decisions before submission](https://github.com/IamMikeHelsel/ctrl/blob/target/research-notebook-20261017/research-notebook/research/pods/2026-10-18/recovery-handoff-02/QUESTIONS-BEFORE-SUBMISSION.txt). The earlier [controls team review](https://github.com/IamMikeHelsel/ctrl/tree/target/research-notebook-20261017/research-notebook/publication/controls-team-review-20261018) retains the original theorem and controls/Lean novelty assessment.

General execution existence, coverage of the full stopping-to-admission region, event-to-hold composition, precision standstill, contact mechanics and practical advantage remain open. A driven axis with bounded braking delay is a candidate application; no hardware has established its assumptions. These proof milestones are ready for internal review, not submission. The earlier manuscripts have not been expanded to claim these results.

This remains a private draft. No external contact, hardware acceptance, public release, paper submission or merge occurred. Notebook proof evidence uses its retained pins and remains separate from the repository library CI.
title: Preserve independently reviewed controls and mathematics research
